name: Spoken Step
description: Speak a path into being under the foot and walk it to the far end of the field.

name: Spoken Guard
description: Speak a guard into being before the body that holds for as long as the word is held.

name: Spoken Mend
description: Speak whole flesh over an ally's wounds and watch the edges close at the sound.

name: Spoken Gift
description: Speak strength into the limbs of an ally and set it there for the length of the fight.

name: Word Lance
description: Speak a lance into being and send it through the foe's guard in the same breath.

name: Word Aegis
description: Speak a bastion round the user and allies that turns blows and renews their strength.

name: Word Chain
description: Speak chains of made matter round every foe in earshot and fix them in place.

name: Word Renewal
description: Speak breath and pulse back into an ally who has just fallen within the moments allowed.

name: First Word
description: Speak a syllable of the first word over the field with a weight set by the core's reserve.

name: Word Sovereign
description: Speak a command over the field that stills lesser wills and shields the speaker's side.

name: Spoken World
description: Speak a land into being over the field and bring it down on all within up to the ceiling of a Core-tier master.

name: Granted Existence
description: Make a thing that never was and set it in the past so that it always was; no cultivation mechanic explains how.

name: Sovereign Step
description: Make a path of divine matter and cross a great distance along it in a single stride.

name: Sovereign Guard
description: Make a guard of divine matter that holds against the heaviest blows of the field.

name: Sovereign Mend
description: Make whole flesh of divine matter over an ally's gravest wounds.

name: Sovereign Gift
description: Make strength of divine matter and give it to an ally to carry through the fight.

name: Sovereign Lance
description: Make a lance of divine matter and drive it through a rank of foes.

name: Sovereign Carapace
description: Make a bastion of divine matter over the user and allies that turns blows and renews strength.

name: Sovereign Bind
description: Make bonds of divine matter about every foe in sight and set them fast.

name: Sovereign Renewal
description: Make breath and pulse for an ally whose life has just ended and call them back within moments.

name: Sovereign Decree
description: Make a decree of divine matter over the field whose weight follows the reserve poured into it.

name: Sovereign Work
description: Make a finished work of divine matter that shields the user's side and seals the foes outside it.

name: Sovereign Hand
description: Make a vast hand of divine matter that falls on one foe with a weight set by the reserve.

name: Sovereign Calamity
description: Make a land of divine matter over a region and bring it down on all within up to the ceiling of a divine master.

name: Made Cosmos
description: Make a small world of its own ground and sky around the field for an hour; no cultivation mechanic explains where its matter comes from.
